column3: LAURA: If your victory can be a point of pride for you, then that's more than enough for me.
FLORA: ...Whatever.
You put up a decent fight, I guess.
(And it is nice to see someone with Grass Types in a high position...)
(Maybe not EVERYONE here is worthless.)
But you are seriously WAY too nice for your own good.
LAURA: I........ do hear that from time to time.
I don't suppose you've met my younger sister, have you?
I believe the two of you might get along very well.
Possibly dangerously well........
........Perhaps it is for the best that you do not meet.
FLORA: I'll put it on my bucket list.
I'm going ahead.
LAURA: She seems to be of a similar type of girl to my own sisters.
I think all of them would be much benefitted by setting down their respective objectives, and learning to enjoy a moment of tranquility among the flowers.
I don't know her that well, but is it too naive to hope that, perhaps knowing that is why she uses Grass Types herself?
It really is good to see you back here once more.
Did you see how well the flowers in my garden have been growing recently?
In moments like these, I'm grateful to have someone else here to witness their beauty, too.
Shall we enjoy a moment to admire them together?
LAURA: Any moment shared with you is one to be cherished.
I hope that the rest of your moments today are just as beautiful.
You're always welcome in my garden whenever you please.
LAURA: I hope that the rest of your moments today are just as beautiful.
Yes
No
ELIAS: Dominus vobiscum.
So you return.
Repetita iuvant, but let us hope your conviction is stronger for it.
With no time to waste,
Let us test them at once.
Show me the spirit He has placed unto you!
ELIAS: Descensus in cuniculi cavum...
You go ever-onward through madness and monster alike.
I implore you, though with little merit to it, to not think of me now as the latter.
As I have failed in my duty, my master has passed.
As he has passed, so has my contract.
Cuiusvis hominis est errare, nullius nisi insipientis in errore perseverare.
Only a fool persists in his faults.
My loyalty now lies not with mortals, but the Lord.
And even I could not be blind enough to believe that that woman acts in His interest.
I understand that the one who fares the best against her is you.
You have always had the blessing of power, have you not?
I first heard of how it shone atop Pyrous Mountain.
Thus, retribution is a mission I will entrust to you.
It is not the only thing.
I wager this against you--
Thus, I wager this against you--
The Emerald Brooch.
This artifact of my Lord will choose its own fate.
Your light...
My conviction...
Let us witness firsthand which His destiny favors!
ELIAS: Virtus tentamine gaudet.
Yours is a power that grows with defeat.
Against this, even she will not last.
Your way is clear.
ELIAS: Your belief has won this fight.
I give this freely.
ELIAS: Let destiny carry you to your true purpose.
That, not even my Lord may predict.
I, for one, will pray my daughter lies safely somewhere at the end of it.
Until next time, pax vobiscum, and adieu.
ELIAS: Little have I gained and not lost.
Beauty is said to be in the eye of the beholder,
But what good is sight without that which one loves to gaze upon?
Even my Lord does not permit me to see Him.
Dominus illuminatio mea...
The Lord is my light,
But men may not stare into the sun.
Perhaps before the end, I will return the gift I have been granted after all.
FLORA: What.
Hello, excuse me?
Do you perhaps speak English?
Or have you not interacted with humans since the age of Garufans?
I'd believe you're that old.
ELIAS: Ahem.
I was briefly informed as to the circumstances of your visit, my Lord, but I must admit I find them peculiar.
FLORA: "My Lord"?
You mean \PN?
ELIAS: I do.
FLORA: A "Lord"?
ELIAS: Yes.
FLORA: Ahahaha-hahahaha!
ELIAS: It is no joke, puella.
For as it was told unto me, \PN is the assumed avatar of the Lord Arceus.
For all the miracles that He has brought since first He appeared, I believe there can be no reasonable doubt of this.
For it was He who did spare this region from the shadow of a prior threat, and He did bring justice upon the killer of my former master.
And it was He who disappeared when the long fight was over and the Lord Arceus was at last freed from its prison.
I am only thankful that He came back to us.
For all the miracles that She has brought since first She appeared, I believe there can be no reasonable doubt of this.
For it was She who did spare this region from the shadow of a prior threat, and She did bring justice upon the killer of my former master.
And it was She who disappeared when the long fight was over and the Lord Arceus was at last freed from its prison.
I am only thankful that She came back to us.
For all the miracles that They have brought since first They appeared, I believe there can be no reasonable doubt of this.
For it was They who did spare this region from the shadow of a prior threat, and They did bring justice upon the killer of my former master.
And it was They who disappeared when the long fight was over and the Lord Arceus was at last freed from its prison.
I am only thankful that They came back to us.
FLORA: Wait, you're really not joking?
With people like you around and in charge, there's no wonder this backwards-ass region is such a mess.
\PN, tell him you're not secretly an Arceus or whatever. Seriously.
ELIAS: As your ever-humble servant, it pleases me to know that I am understood and, in the light of your grace, accepted.
FLORA: You've got to be fucking kidding me.
Are you seriously feeding into this?
You must be even more of an egomaniac than I expected.
ELIAS: A prank...
I have considered this, of course.
However, the evidence is too overwhelming.
The timing could not be coincidental, and what you have, in ending the prior conflict, done for me personally cannot be discounted.
Therefore, I can only see this moment for what it is--
A test of faith.
Rest assured, my Lord, mine remains ever-steady.
FLORA: Are you fucking kidding me?
Hello? Earth to resident living relic???
IT'S NOT REAL.
\PN is just another person.
ELIAS: In order to call oneself a true believer, one must have unshakeable faith.
I am afraid that your tricks will not deceive me.
FLORA: I'm going to jump out one of those pretty stained glass windows.
ELIAS: Though I cannot help but feel this command is in response to my prior opposition in servitude to my former master,
As I am your willing vessel and servant, my Lord, so it shall be done.
ELIAS: My loyalty and faith is yours now and ever- forward.
FLORA: BAHAHAH!!!
Ahahahaha-hahahahahaha!!!
FLORA: Okay, \PN, that was a good one.
But seriously, if we keep on with this any more, you're gonna see last night's dinner all over the floor, and nobody wants that.
ELIAS: Regardless, though I may be in your care and servitude, I am tasked with another role here.
Regardless, though I may be in your care and servitude, I am tasked with another role here.
It would be remiss of me to not oppose you within these halls merely on the basis of my support for you.
After all, if it were not what you wished, you would not have willed me to be here.
FLORA: ...That logic doesn't even make sense.
You could just use that to justify whatever bullshit power you wanted to do.
In fact, that's not even hypothetical-- isn't that exactly what every major religious organization has done for centuries?!
People like you are the reason that so many have suffered under systems of oppression!
\PN, I've heard enough of this.
Let's help grandpa back into his grave!
FLORA: ...\PN.
How did you come all the way here and not even bring a full team to fight with?
Do you WANT me to lose?
(Seriously, how did this moron ever get to be champion...)
Go back and get some actual goddamn Pokémon before I lose my fucking patience already!
FLORA: Hey, \PN?
What are you doing?
Did you perhaps somehow manage to forget that you need to PICK SOME POKÉMON?!
I am made whole again, and you may proceed onwards with purpose divine.
FLORA: Great, I'm getting out of here yesterday.
ELIAS: It is, and always will be, my pleasure to serve in the cause of the Lord.
You grace me again with your presence on this day, my Lord.
As always, I am ever-grateful to hold a moment of your time.
It is my pleasure to be considered an opponent worthy of you.
As expected.
Your power and grace remain ever-radiant, my Lord.
Your skills are unmatched, even in this form.
I do hope that if you desire to sharpen them further, I may be granted the privilege to be your opponent once more.
ELIAS: Your power and grace remain ever- radiant, my Lord.
I do hope that if you desire to sharpen your skills further, I may be granted the privilege to be your opponent once more.
You honor me
It's just a prank
Bow before me
ANNA: You're back.
It's okay.
Haven't you noticed the continuity gets a little confusing whenever you lose?
Nostra and I are trying to brush over any hiccoughs as much as possible, but we can't do it perfectly.
Let's give it one more shot, okay?
Nostra, we're going again!
ANNA: \PN! You made it!
Sorry for disappearing just before everything went crazy, but I had a lot of things I needed to do...
Still, you got through everything and made it here!
That's exactly what I'd expect from the one Nostra chose!
Anyway, there's a LOT that I have to explain now.
I'm sorry for not telling you these things sooner, but I get so caught up in trying to make everything work that I just forget to explain it right.
Basically...
This isn't the first time this has happened.
This conflict with Team Meteor suddenly escalating to this point...
Even everything that happened with Heather's dad, and those sorority girls, and the teacher at Apophyll...
So much of this happened before.
But back then, it was different-- and faster.
The old champion died alongside you, when you would have first come to the region.
Truthfully I don't even remember it myself; I just know what Nostra told me.
Back then, I made a wish to try and save the world.
It was such an earth-shattering, reality-bending wish that Nostra could hardly maintain her presence in the world she rewound.
That's why she's like this, you know?
And it's not just her-- that boy, too.
His body was the sacrifice necessary to rewind the world so dramatically.
But that wish...
It brought me you, \PN.
Trying to control an entire timeline just on Nostra's guidance alone has been tough...
Unexpected things kept happening, but we've tried to correct it as much as possible.
After all, if things became too different, Nostra wouldn't know how to help.
I'm sure I've caused you a lot of inconveniences that way, even if you didn't know it.
For instance, even though Ame was still alive, I asked her to stay out of things long enough so that you would gain enough experience to persevere.
You have to believe me when I say that everything I've done was just to build you up strong enough so that you could eventually defeat Lin!
Before, she was too powerful for anyone to take on.
You being here and opposing them has slowed them down so much!
And soon, you should be able to beat her!
I'll try and make it short though.
You may not believe me, and that's okay.
Things haven't gone exactly as planned...
But you should be able to beat her!
You're like a pawn that reached the end of the board.
And this is the final stage of my wish!
Nostra!
Please finish the job!
With this battle, you'll have the strength you need to finally face Lin!
This is your promotion!
ANNA: There you go.
No need to worry.
We've rewound her part of time again for you.
We'll do it as much as it takes until you win.
After all, I said we'd be right there with you, right?
This victory belongs to you.
Now go for it!
ANNA: That's it, then...
Take a rest, Nostra.
After everything and so long, you've beyond earned it.
And, \PN?
Thank you for playing this game with me.
I've been... really, horribly selfish.
Not only didn't I tell anyone what was going on, but I--
I guess I've been running from the fact that this was all my fault to begin with.
You see, Lin--
Isn't what she seems.
When I was still at the orphanage, we all used to play games as much as we could together.
And there was one game that I was always the best at.
Chess, of course!
No one could even stand a chance against me...  except for one other girl.
Her name was Lin.
In the end, we developed kind of a rivalry.
I thought it was all in good spirits fun until one day, I suddenly reversed a losing game on her and won.
She snapped at me, and the Doctor got angry, and both of them started yelling and...
Well, I never saw her again after she was put into the Circuit.
I heard she escaped that night, but the Doctor refused to ever talk about it.
Then, before long, the Lin we know now appeared and started pulling strings elsewhere.
There's no doubt in my mind that it's the same Lin.
And I think...
All of this has still been some kind of game to her.
She hasn't come after me in specific...
But if I were her opponent, would she?
I know I'm such a child to have let a stupid rivalry come this far.
But that's all the more reason why we have to end it now!
I couldn't do it myself before.
That's why I'm counting on you.
Thank you for everything.
Please...
ANNA: Take this.
ANNA: It may seem like a bad thing at first, but trust me.
This is for the best.
We'll be right there with you too, okay?
You can do it.
Because you're the one Nostra chose.
Because you've already come this far.
And because...
For everyone's sake, we have to win.
ANNA: Go ahead.
You aren't fighting this battle alone.
Me, Nostra, your Pokémon...
We're all with you to the very end.
AME: Anna's a great kid, but somebody needs to tell her to treat her toys better...
I can't believe she requested this set-up...
She said something about it being because she feels guilty, but I don't... get it.
I should never have approved this, I should never have approved this~...
Celebi seems curious about who that voice belonged to.
Celebi seems pretty tired out after all the time travel.
Celebi seems full of energy and ready to go!
Do you want to travel through time again?
You once again feel your surroundings fade away around you as Celebi brings you forward through time!
Celebi looks a little impatient, but will wait for you.
TAKA: But why would she be in here, she's not Elite Four...
TAKA: ...I don't really like this room.
I didn't have proper toys growing up--
So, seeing all of this is kind of...
ELIAS: Of course it's her.
Another person whose death I am responsible for.
ELIAS: As eerie I find this room, she at least made the right choice going for stairs.
My floating platforms constantly break.
TAKA: We're so close to our time, the next jump will have to get us back, right?
ELIAS: We should be going back to the present now.
These meetings have all been...
I'm glad I got to see them all again.
AME: Shimmer, give me a boost.
I can almost reach them...
AME: Gah!
Officer, I swear, I didn't sneak into Anna's room while she was away with the sole purpose of rescuing all these toys!
That's a preposterous accusation which I can't believe you'd make!
I'm hurt!
Wounded!
My heart weeps at the mere insinuation!
AME: And even if it were true...
I shan't be pressured and shamed by some thuggish officer of the state for trying to do the right thing!
I will give each of these toys a safe home, and nobody is going to stop me!
...This doesn't mean you're Champion now, right?
AME: Whoa, what kind of officer are you that you can beat me so easily!?
TAKA: Uh, hi. We're nothing to do with the police...
TAKA: I'm Taka. And you just battled \PN.
We're kind of from the future.
AME: Oh! And over there must be that time traveling lettuce Pokémon I saw in one of the books in Elias' room?
TAKA: ...Do you make a habit of going into the Elite Four's rooms when they aren't here?
AME: Do you make a habit of impersonating police?
That sounds like a crime.
TAKA: We didn't... Nevermind.
Celebi just needs to rest before time traveling-- so we've been making small jumps to get back home.
It seems like we're pretty close to our time period though, so we can get out of your hair and leave you to...
Doing nothing criminal whatsoever, I guess.
AME: Hey, hold up a minute...
\PN, right? You're a very talented trainer.
Have you challenged the League in your time?
If not, you should-- you might have what it takes to go all the way!
TAKA: About that...
\PN is your successor as Champion.
AME: Wait, so you've beaten me twice now?
That's incredible!
My dream was to build up this League to attract the best trainers from all around the world...
And clearly it worked! I couldn't be happier!
To think my League attracted such an incredible trainer...
Well, don't let me keep you!
You should get back to your time-- say "Hi" to me when you get back!
I will give each of these toys a safe home, and nobody is going stop me!
AME: Whoa, what kind of officer are you that you can beat me so--
Wait, Elias!? Is this trainer with you?
Did you sneak in here to rescue all of Anna's toys?
Bringing a friend was a good call; I'm struggling to reach.
ELIAS: Amethyst.
That's very much your hobby, not mine.
AME: I have no idea what you're talking about.
I have never done anything of questionable legality in my life.
Shimmer appears to be doing a dance to try to distract you while Ame hides a definitely-stolen Cleffa doll.
ELIAS: ...
ELIAS: Amethyst, this is \PN. They are--
AME: From the future, right?
ELIAS: How did you--
AME: Oh, please, one doesn't get to be the head of a League without learning a few things here and there.
It can time travel, right?
Although honestly, what I noticed first was you.
You seem a bit... softer.
ELIAS: If you say so.
Ahem, well, yes. We're from... I'm not sure exactly how far, but definitely the future.
AME: Well however long it is, I'm glad you seem to be a bit less high-strung.
Anyway though!
Who is this \PN person, and why are you both in the past?
ELIAS: Ah, he is...
ELIAS: Ah, she is...
ELIAS: Ah, they are...
The next Champion of Reborn.
You did your job well.
AME: Thanks El, that's very sweet of you...
Wait.
Did you just say Champion?
So... the League really works?
Inviting trainers from all around the world, and one manages to win...
And one so brilliantly talented, too!
